body.p: If you want to join an organization, chances are that you receive an invitation to join that organization. In that case just follow the invitation link that will get you to sign-up into that organization.
In case you do not have an invitation, then you need to know the organization ID. You can start on the Cloud main page:
and use the I know my organization ID action and follow the steps to complete the sign-up process.
During this process you will be asked to:

ul.li: Provide the Organization ID. This identifier will be used to generate the organization URL.
Sign up within the organization. If you were invited already then a user role will be assigned to you, otherwise you can request that an administrator assign you a user role.
